title: Ultrafast and Anisotropic Exciton Transport in Layered NbOI$_2$
abstract: Ferroelectric layered semiconductors provide a unique platform for exploring coupled excitonic and electronic phenomena in reduced dimensions. Here, exciton transport in layered NbOI$_2$ is investigated using transient absorption microscopy. Ultrafast and strongly anisotropic exciton diffusion is observed. The diffusion coefficient of about 160 cm$^2$ s$^{-1}$ along the nonpolar crystal axis is among the highest reported for van der Waals semiconductors. The transport exhibits an approximately twofold in-plane anisotropy between the polar and nonpolar directions, reflecting the intrinsic low-symmetry crystal structure of NbOI$_2$. The environmental stability of NbOI$_2$ is further investigated, and fabrication and encapsulation conditions required to achieve long-term sample stability are identified. These results establish NbOI$_2$ as a promising platform for studying anisotropic exciton transport and highlight the critical role of interface protection in air-sensitive van der Waals materials.

summaries.en: Transient absorption microscopy reveals ultrafast, strongly anisotropic exciton diffusion in layered NbOI2, with a diffusion coefficient of about 160 cm2 s-1 along the nonpolar axis and an approximately twofold in-plane anisotropy reflecting the crystal's low symmetry.
summaries.zh: 瞬态吸收显微成像揭示了层状NbOI2中超快且强各向异性的激子扩散，沿非极性晶轴的扩散系数约为160 cm2 s-1，并且极性方向与非极性方向之间约两倍的面内各向异性反映了该晶体固有的低对称结构。

title: The Spectroscopic Atlas of Excitonic Complexes in hBN-Encapsulated S-TMD Monolayers: From Excitons to Oxcitons and Beyond
abstract: Hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) encapsulation has transformed the optical spectroscopy of semiconducting transition-metal dichalcogenide monolayers (MLs) by suppressing extrinsic disorder and enabling the resolution of an increasingly complex hierarchy of excitonic states. This Review provides a spectroscopy-oriented framework for understanding and identifying excitonic complexes in hBN-encapsulated Mo- and W-based MLs and their alloys. The discussion covers bright and dark excitons, Rydberg states, charged excitons, biexcitons, phonon-assisted replicas, and higher-order Fermi-sea many-body states, including hexcitons and oxcitons, with an emphasis on the experimental signatures that distinguish them. Particular attention is given to the combined use of photoluminescence and absorption-related spectroscopy, electrostatic gating, polarization analysis, excitation-power and temperature dependences, magnetic fields, and time-resolved measurements to establish microscopic assignments. The role of alloying as an additional degree of freedom for engineering the excitonic hierarchy, spin-valley configuration, and magneto-optical response is also highlighted. By organizing the rapidly expanding phenomenology around experimentally accessible fingerprints rather than individual material systems, this Review aims to provide a practical and broadly applicable guide for identifying, comparing, and engineering excitonic states in high-quality two-dimensional semiconductors.
subjects: Mesoscale and Nanoscale Physics (cond-mat.mes-hall) ; Materials Science (cond-mat.mtrl-sci)

summaries.en: This review provides a spectroscopy-oriented framework for identifying the hierarchy of excitonic complexes—from bright and dark excitons, Rydberg states, charged excitons, and biexcitons to phonon-assisted replicas and higher-order Fermi-sea many-body states such as hexcitons and oxcitons—in hBN-encapsulated Mo- and W-based transition-metal dichalcogenide monolayers and their alloys, emphasizing the experimental fingerprints from photoluminescence and absorption spectroscopy, electrostatic gating, polarization analysis, power- and temperature-dependence, magnetic fields, and time-resolved measurements that enable microscopic assignment and engineering of these states.

title: Magnetization and Josephson current coupling drives the Josephson diode effect in FeTe0.55Se0.45 van der Waals junctions
abstract: The Josephson diode effect (JDE) reflects symmetry breaking in the current-phase relation (CPR) of Josephson junctions, yet establishing its microscopic origin is often challenging. We investigate the mechanism of the JDE in van der Waals Josephson junctions based on FeTe0.55Se0.45, a platform where superconductivity, topology, and magnetism may coexist at the interface. Our devices exhibit a robust zero-field diode response with asymmetric switching currents. Magnetic-field measurements reveal a hysteretic Fraunhofer pattern and magnetic-resonance-induced voltage feature, evidencing interfacial magnetism coupled to the Josephson current. Microwave response further shows half-integer Shapiro steps with asymmetric evolution, demonstrating contributions from both a second harmonic and a magnetization-induced phase shift in CPR. Numerical simulations combining magnetization dynamics and Josephson phase dynamics reproduce these features, confirming that the JDE originates from interfacial coupling between magnetization and Josephson current. This work provides a transport-based route to pinpoint the microscopic mechanism of the JDE, establishing a platform for exploring magnetically active interfacial superconductivity, and enables the design of nonreciprocal superconducting devices in clean, interface-engineered van der Waals systems.

title: Super-tetragonal ferroelectric barium titanate through anionic overstoichiometry
abstract: Ferroelectric oxides, characterized by an electrical polarization that is switchable with an electric field, are an appealing class of materials for energy-efficient computing, electronics, and photonics. In thin films, the properties of ferroelectrics are commonly tuned using substrate-imposed epitaxial strain, an approach limited to biaxial strain states and a finite number of available substrates. Here, we demonstrate that is is possible to move beyond conventional epitaxial growth by using pulsed laser deposition under highly non-equilibrium conditions. Specifically, we show that this unconventional processing route allows us to stabilize a super-tetragonal phase of ferroelectric $\text{BaTiO}_3$. The key to this stabilization lies in the insertion of surplus oxygen atoms into the unit cell, resulting in peroxide bond formation that give rise to an aspect ratio of as high as 1.08. Notably, this super-tetragonal phase exhibits an enhanced ferroelectric polarization, reduced coercivity, lower leakage currents, and increased cycling endurance compared to conventional bulk-like $\text{BaTiO}_3$ films. These results, thus, showcase the potential of non-equilibrium growth for defect engineering to obtain emergent phases in complex oxides and tune their physical properties in thin films expanding the scope of traditional epitaxy.

summaries.en: Highly non-equilibrium pulsed laser deposition stabilizes a super-tetragonal phase of ferroelectric BaTiO3 through surplus oxygen insertion and peroxide bond formation, yielding an aspect ratio up to 1.

title: From hard-core to soft-core bosons in a shell trap
abstract: We study the low-temperature states of a system of spinless bosons trapped in a broad spherical shell. In our virtual (path-integral Monte Carlo) experiments, we specifically examine how the equilibrium structure and overall superfluidity of the system are affected by a change of the interparticle-potential core from hard to increasingly soft. In this manner we bridge the gap between the behaviors of two species of bosons: Helium-like atoms, which self-assemble into ordinary crystalline solids, and Rydberg-dressed atoms, which in simulation form cluster (super)solids. We also vary the particle mass, i.e., the quantumness of the system, so as to modify the relative stability of ``solid'' and fluid states. We thus find a whole spectrum of (finite-size) phases with a curved structure, including multilayer and cluster phases, as well as superfluids and single layer supersolids. In particular, we confirm that supersolids only occur in the presence of clusters. By considering three system sizes (from 60 to 180 particles), but rescaling the trap radius so that the density stays fixed, we verify that supersolid states only exist in the same range of particle masses. Our model serves as a platform to test how emergent properties are modified, in spherical geometry, in the crossover from atoms to dressed atoms.

summaries.en: Using path-integral Monte Carlo simulations of spinless bosons in a spherical shell trap, the study shows that changing the interparticle potential from hard-core to increasingly soft-core, together with varying particle mass, produces a spectrum of finite-size phases including multilayer and cluster phases, superfluids, and single-layer supersolids, with supersolids occurring only in the presence of clusters.

title: Microstructural evolution during isothermal tempering of a highly supersaturated metastable austenitic state of a PM high-speed steel
abstract: This study investigates the microstructural evolution of the powder metallurgical high-speed steel PM HS 3-3-4 during isothermal holding within the transformation gap between pearlite and bainite formation. The focus is on the mechanism of carbide spheroidization and the proposed formation of a chemically graded carbide rim. The heat treatments were carried out in a quenching dilatometer, enabling precise control of the thermal cycles and isothermal holding conditions. Spatially resolved analytic microscopy techniques, including scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM), Auger electron spectroscopy (AES) and atom probe tomography (APT), image analysis and complementary thermodynamic simulations (MatCalc) were used to characterize the carbide evolution. Isothermal holding increased carbide circularity, carbide volume fraction, and hardness, while MatCalc calculations predict a strong thermodynamic driving force for additional carbide precipitation. The analytic techniques revealed a compositional gradient of approximately 15 nm at the carbide-matrix interface in the isothermally treated condition, compared with a sharp transition of only 2-3 nm in the directly quenched state. This nanometer-scale gradient provides strong evidence for epitaxial, interface-controlled carbide growth and the formation of a chemically graded carbide rim. The associated solute depletion of the surrounding austenite provides a plausible explanation for its reduced stability, reflected by an increase in the martensite start temperature. The combined results demonstrate that isothermal holding promotes interfacial chemical reorganization, offering new insights into carbide spheroidization and providing a basis for tailoring carbide morphology and the resulting mechanical properties through heat treatment.

summaries.en: Isothermal holding of a highly supersaturated metastable austenitic PM high-speed steel promotes epitaxial, interface-controlled carbide growth that creates an approximately 15 nm chemically graded carbide rim and solute-depleted austenite, increasing carbide circularity, volume fraction, and hardness while raising the martensite start temperature.

title: Zero-group-velocity modes in textured steel plates: experiments and elastic modeling
abstract: Zero-group-velocity (ZGV) resonances are investigated as a non-contact ultrasonic probe of elastic anisotropy in textured steel plates. Directional laser-ultrasonic measurements were performed on 70% cold-rolled Ti-stabilized interstitial-free steel plates in the full-hard and recrystallized condition. Experimental results were compared with predictions based on effective elastic stiffness tensors derived from X-ray diffraction measurements. Classical Voigt-Reuss-Hill estimates and microstructure-resolved finite-element homogenization reproduce the measured angular dependence of the ZGV frequencies well for both states, with the finite-element KUBC/SUBC bounds considerably narrower than the classical Voigt-Reuss bounds. For the full-hard state, agreement with the texture-based model is obtained only after a recovery treatment. This indicates that dislocations present in the full-hard material contribute to its elastic response, an interpretation that is further supported by theoretical estimations. An identifiability analysis shows that the directional ZGV measurements provide access to at least three independently observable combinations of the stiffness tensor components, and concluding suggestions for application in recrystallization monitoring are provided.
subjects: Materials Science (cond-mat.mtrl-sci) ; Applied Physics (physics.app-ph); Data Analysis, Statistics and Probability (physics.data-an); Optics (physics.optics)

summaries.en: Directional laser-ultrasonic measurements of zero-group-velocity resonances in textured steel plates, combined with Voigt-Reuss-Hill and microstructure-resolved finite-element predictions from X-ray texture data, reproduce the measured angular dependence of the ZGV frequencies and reveal that dislocations in the full-hard state contribute to the elastic response.

title: Effect of Annealing on Maze Domains in Topological Insulator - Magnetic Multilayer Heterostructures
abstract: Combining topological insulators with chiral magnetic multilayers offers the opportunity to greatly enhance the spin-orbit torque (SOT) driven manipulation of hosted spin textures, however this also exposes devices to the often poor temperature stability of the commonly used, Bi$_2$X$_3$-based (X is a chalcogenic element), topological insulator films. In this work we demonstrate through in-situ-annealing and polarised neutron reflectometry that the multilayer at a Bi$_2$Se$_3$ interface remains magnetically robust up to a temperature of 350 $^{\circ}$C: even as the Bi$_2$Se$_3$ epilayer structurally deteriorates. Through x-ray photoemission electron microscopy, an intermediate annealing temperature of $\sim$ 200 $^{\circ}$C was found to improve the domain ordering of the multilayer, allowing for field-induced skyrmion nucleation, all whilst sustaining minimal damage to the topological insulator

summaries.en: In-situ annealing and polarized neutron reflectometry show that a chiral magnetic multilayer interfaced with Bi2Se3 remains magnetically robust up to 350 °C despite structural deterioration of the topological insulator, while an intermediate annealing temperature of about 200 °C improves domain ordering and enables field-induced skyrmion nucleation with minimal damage to the topological insulator.

title: Robust Anomalous Hall Effect in Epitaxial Cubic D0$_3$-Fe$_3$Ge Nanoplates Grown by Chemical Vapor Deposition
abstract: The iron-based ferromagnetic materials have emerged as a promising system for spintronics due to their high Curie temperatures and significant anomalous Hall effect (AHE) driven by Berry curvature. While there have been investigations into the epitaxial growth of non-layered iron-based ferromagnetic materials, the realization of high-quality single crystal thin films continues to be a formidable obstacle. Meanwhile, the issues such as grain boundary scattering further hinder their characterization and application. Here, we report the first chemical vapor deposition (CVD) synthesis of single-crystalline cubic D0$_3$-Fe$_3$Ge nanoplates. This compound represents a substantial departure from the conventional hexagonal phases typically observed in the Fe-Ge system. Structural characterizations confirm the cubic lattice and stoichiometric purity of the crystals. Structural analysis identifies a strong epitaxial effect, resulting in a giant compressive strain of ~4.16% at the interface that relaxes gradually toward the surface. The second-harmonic generation (SHG) signals might further reveal that such interfacial strain disrupted the inherent centro-symmetry of the cubic phase. SQUID magnetometry shows robust room-temperature ferromagnetism and clear magnetic anisotropy. Magneto-transport measurements reveal a robust AHE that remains stable at temperatures far exceeding room temperature. The scaling observed between the anomalous Hall resistance and longitudinal resistance strongly suggests that this effect is dominated by the intrinsic Berry curvature mechanism. Furthermore, density functional theory (DFT) calculations reveal that the huge epitaxial strain induces band reconstructions and creates dense spin-orbit coupling gaps near the Fermi level, effectively doubling the anomalous Hall conductivity to match our experimental observations.

summaries.en: Single-crystalline cubic D0$_3$-Fe$_3$Ge nanoplates were synthesized for the first time by chemical vapor deposition, exhibiting a giant interfacial compressive strain of ~4.

title: Charge Density Wave transient states induced by ultrashort hard X-ray pulses
abstract: The interaction of quantum systems with ultrashort laser pulses may lead to transient states far from equilibrium. Among these, Charge Density Wave (CDW) systems offer very rich non-equilibrium physics when submitted to ultrashort optical excitations in the infrared regime. In this Letter, we show that CDW systems pumped by ultrashort x-ray pulses excite the system in very different way. The x-ray pump, 6000 times more energetic than a laser pulse, pumping and probing the whole bulk system simultaneously, drives CDW systems in a novel reversible out of equilibrium state. The successive CDW states observed in the NbSe$_3$ system with respect to the arrival of x-ray pulses follow a non-thermal kinetic path. It is characterized by a change in 2k$_F$ wavevector, correlation lengths and electronic gap, as well as a change of dimensionality, all of this takes place within a very long recovery time ranging from 450$ns$ to 0.01$s$. Several scenarios are proposed, including transient nucleation and recombination of charged topological objects.

summaries.en: Ultrashort hard X-ray pulses, which are about 6000 times more energetic than infrared laser pulses and pump and probe the entire bulk simultaneously, drive the charge density wave system NbSe3 into a novel reversible out-of-equilibrium state that evolves along a non-thermal kinetic path characterized by changes in the 2kF wavevector, correlation lengths, electronic gap, and dimensionality, with recovery times ranging from 450 ns to 0.

title: Unambiguous determination of the THz conductivity in driven YBa$_2$Cu$_3$O$_{6+x}$
abstract: Mid-infrared pump, THz probe experiments in YBa$_2$Cu$_3$O$_{6+x}$ yield evidence of a high-temperature transient state of the material with the optical properties of a superconductor. However, there are ambiguities in the extracted transient c-axis THz optical properties, primarily resulting from the sublinear growth of the THz response with increasing mid-infrared pump fluence. It was proposed that this effect may be related to saturation of the material's response, which would then perturb its spatial profile and lead one to overestimate the induced change in the transient optical properties. Yet, sublinear growth of the signal could also arise from other effects unrelated to saturation, for example from a change in reflectivity or deposition depth for the pump pulses. Here, we remove this ambiguity by experimentally measuring the fluence-dependent complex optical constants at the 15-20 THz frequencies of the pump. We show that the observed sublinear growth is to be attributed in large part to the enhanced reflection and reduced penetration depth of the pump field at high fluences. When taking into account these findings, we confirm the original interpretation of a light-induced superconducting state both qualitatively and quantitatively.

summaries.en: By experimentally measuring the fluence-dependent complex optical constants at the 15-20 THz pump frequencies, the authors show that the sublinear growth of the THz response in photoexcited YBa2Cu3O6+x arises largely from enhanced pump reflection and reduced penetration depth at high fluences, thereby removing ambiguity and confirming both qualitatively and quantitatively the light-induced superconducting state.
summaries.zh: 通过实验测量15-20 THz泵浦频率下随注量变化的复光学常数，作者表明光激发YBa2Cu3O6+x中太赫兹响应的亚线性增长主要源于高注量下泵浦场反射增强和穿透深度减小，从而消除了歧义，并在定性和定量上确认了光致超导态。
summaries.ja: 15-20 THzのポンプ周波数におけるフルエンス依存の複素光学定数を実験的に測定することで、著者らは光励起YBa2Cu3O6+xにおけるTHz応答の亜線形増大が主に高フルエンスでのポンプ場の反射増大と侵入深さの減少に起因することを示し、曖昧さを取り除いて光誘起超伝導状態を定性的かつ定量的に確認した。

title: Chiral near-fields at achiral plasmonic tips enable nanoscale valley polarimetry
abstract: Optical helicity is central to chiral light-matter interactions, yet plasmonic confinement typically distorts it at the nanoscale. Here, we demonstrate nanoscale valley polarimetry using an achiral Au tip, where incidence-angle control of circularly polarized light creates a strongly localized, helicity-preserving near-field. Chiral tip-enhanced photoluminescence (c-TEPL) directly resolves and reverses local valley polarization in monolayer WSe2 and reveals nanoscale polarization variations in strained MoS2 hidden by diffraction-limited measurements.

summaries.en: An achiral gold plasmonic tip enables nanoscale valley polarimetry by generating a strongly localized, helicity-preserving near-field through incidence-angle control of circularly polarized light, with chiral tip-enhanced photoluminescence resolving and reversing local valley polarization in monolayer WSe2 and revealing nanoscale polarization variations in strained MoS2 that are hidden by diffraction-limited measurements.

title: Cavity optomechanical magnetometer actuated by substrate bending
abstract: We describe a magnetic field sensor based on a monolithic Fabry-Perot cavity. The cavities were fabricated in a thin-film buckling process at one surface of a fused silica chip, and the chip was subsequently bonded to a giant magnetostrictive material (GMM). External magnetic fields drive flexural modes of the assembly and the associated bending stresses are efficiently mapped to changes in the cavity height, with enhanced response at kHz-range mechanical resonance frequencies. A key attribute of this platform is that the size of the transducing material is decoupled from the size of the optical cavity. The buckled cavity operates in low mode order and with moderate Q ~ 103, providing a high optomechanical coupling coefficient while also enabling a straightforward tuned-to-slope readout technique. Peak sensitivity ~ 2 pT/Hz1/2 was achieved in an unshielded laboratory environment, limited by laser phase and electronics noise in the readout system. With future reductions in these noise sources, we predict that a broadband thermomechanical-noise-limited sensitivity in the ~ 0.1 pT/Hz1/2 range is feasible.

summaries.en: A monolithic buckled Fabry-Perot cavity bonded to a giant magnetostrictive material enables a cavity optomechanical magnetometer with peak sensitivity of about 2 pT/Hz^1/2 in an unshielded laboratory environment, limited by laser phase and electronics readout noise, with a predicted broadband thermomechanical-noise-limited sensitivity near 0.

title: Towards a Complete Kerr Soft-Hair Theory: Integrability, Counterterm Equivalence,and Quantum State Counting
abstract: The horizon symmetry construction of Haco, Hawking, Perry, and Strominger yield two Virasoro central charges 12J after a specified Wald-Zoupas correction. Turning that calculation into a black hole microstate theory requires separate control of nonlinear charge integrability, the allowed counter-term class, and quantum state multiplicities. We formulate exact local and global integrability tests, prove uniqueness of the counter-term coefficients within a one-parameter ansatz, and identify the quotient in which a physically meaningful uniqueness theorem must be stated. A coadjoint-orbit model supplies globally defined classical moment maps, while unitary highest-weight modules supply an explicit algebraic quantum realization for macroscopic positive angular momentum, neither construction is proved equivalent to the gravitational phase space. A character calculation shows why a single Virasoro representation, despite having the desired central charge, does not provide the required large-central-charge entropy. We derive a curvature improvement invisible to the constant mode, quantize a regulated area-boost corner polarization, and find a continuous kinematic spectrum with divergent Gibbs trace. Explicit local modular CFT spectra with identical central charges yield different finite-temperature entropies, demonstrating that the available symmetry and quantum consistency data do not select the microscopic theory. We give a conditional sufficiency theorem and a concrete sequence of calculations needed to establish a gravitational completion.

summaries.en: The paper develops exact integrability tests, proves counterterm-coefficient uniqueness within a one-parameter ansatz, and shows via character and modular-CFT calculations that current horizon-symmetry and quantum-consistency data do not single out a black hole microstate theory, offering instead a conditional sufficiency theorem and a sequence of calculations needed for a gravitational completion.
summaries.zh: 本文建立了精确的可积性检验，证明了单参数拟设下抵消项系数的唯一性，并通过特征标和模CFT计算表明当前视界对称性与量子一致性数据不足以唯一确定黑洞微观态理论，转而给出一个条件性充分定理及实现引力完备化所需的一系列计算。
summaries.ja: 本論文は厳密な可積分性検証を定式化し、一パラメータ仮説の下で相殺項係数の一意性を証明するとともに、指標計算とモジュラーCFT計算を通じて、現有の地平線対称性と量子整合性のデータだけではブラックホール微視状態理論を特定できないことを示し、その代わりに条件付き十分性定理と重力論的完成に必要な一連の計算を示す。

title: Second-Order Nonlinear Microresonators on Thin-Film Lithium Tantalate
abstract: Nonlinear frequency conversion enables coherent light generation in spectral regions that conventional lasers cannot reach directly and is foundational to the generation of squeezed states and correlated photon pairs. Implementing these nonlinear processes in microresonators lowers the required optical power by orders of magnitude but requires two conditions to be met simultaneously across wide optical bandwidths: phase matching between the interacting fields, and an appropriate coupling condition to the resonator both in the fundamental and second harmonic band. While the former can be addressed by quasi-phase matching through periodic poling, coupling two widely separated spectral bands to the resonator is nontrivial because of the wavelength dependence of mode overlap. Here, we demonstrate parametric oscillation and efficient second-harmonic generation in periodically poled racetracks on thin-film lithium tantalate on insulator. The proposed resonators feature bus-ring coupling engineered independently in the two spectral bands via a long synchronous directional coupler. Quasi-phase matching is achieved using sidewall poling that is also wavelength-calibrated and locally adapted to compensate for thickness nonuniformities. Together, these two design elements enable second-order parametric oscillation with an on-chip threshold of 181 uW and 9.8% conversion efficiency, with signal and idler tunable over tens of nanometers by a few hundred megahertz of pump detuning. Our design strategy can be flexibly applied to efficient second-harmonic generation, reaching 25% absolute conversion efficiency at milliwatt pump powers. These results show how the coupling condition is a design variable in second-order nonlinear resonators and establish thin-film lithium tantalate as a competitive platform for efficient and low-power frequency conversion.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates second-order parametric oscillation and efficient second-harmonic generation in periodically poled thin-film lithium tantalate racetrack microresonators, using a long synchronous directional coupler for independent bus-ring coupling in the fundamental and second-harmonic bands plus wavelength-calibrated sidewall poling for quasi-phase matching, achieving a 181 µW on-chip oscillation threshold with 9.

title: CRAFT-ε: A Conformer-Resolved Atom- and Fragment-based Theory for the Static Relative Permittivity of Pure Organic Liquids
abstract: The static relative permittivity is an important property in thermodynamic modeling, electrochemistry, and solvent design, but predicting it directly from molecular structure remains challenging because both electronic polarization and molecular dipole orientation contribute to the measured response. Here, we introduce CRAFT-{\epsilon} (Conformer-Resolved Atom- and Fragment-based Theory for {\epsilon}), a conformer-resolved molecular descriptor model for predicting the static relative permittivity of neutral pure liquids. Conformer free energies, molecular dipoles, and atom-resolved polarizabilities are obtained from a GFN2-xTB/ALPB 10 workflow. The molecular dipole is decomposed into chemically defined polar-fragment vectors, allowing fitted corrections to retain both the magnitude and relative orientation of local dipolar contributions. Electronic and orientational polarization are combined with a group-contribution molar volume in the Onsager-Kirkwood-Fröhlich relation. A staged parameterization with 41 parameters is applied to nonpolar, polar, and hydrogen-bonding compounds. For 1393 liquids with permittivities between 1.5 and 183, CRAFT-{\epsilon} reaches a five-fold cross-validated average absolute deviation of 2.40 ({R^2} = 0.93). Conformational averaging 15 is essential for liquids with several polar groups. Compared with an established fragment-based model with 139 parameters, it reaches a similar cross-validated RMSE (3.65 versus 3.41) with about a quarter of the parameters and applies to every liquid of the dataset. The resulting framework provides a computationally inexpensive route from molecular structure to liquid dielectric response and forms a basis for later application to solvent mixtures and electrolyte systems.

summaries.en: CRAFT-ε is a conformer-resolved, atom- and fragment-based descriptor model that combines GFN2-xTB/ALPB-derived dipoles and polarizabilities with a group-contribution molar volume in the Onsager-Kirkwood-Fröhlich relation to predict the static relative permittivity of pure organic liquids, achieving a five-fold cross-validated average absolute deviation of 2.
summaries.zh: CRAFT-ε是一种构象分辨的原子与片段描述符模型，它将GFN2-xTB/ALPB计算得到的偶极矩和极化率与基团贡献摩尔体积结合并代入Onsager-Kirkwood-Fröhlich关系，用于预测纯有机液体的静态相对介电常数，在1393种液体上以仅41个参数实现五折交叉验证平均绝对偏差2.

title: Comprehensive Acoustic Characterization of a Broadband Lateral MEMS Ultrasonic Transducer by Near-Field Acoustic Holography and Coupled Multiphysics Simulation
abstract: Broadband airborne ultrasonic transducers are attractive for applications such as ranging, echo-location, and acoustic material characterization, where wide bandwidths enable advanced excitation and signal-processing techniques. Recently, a lateral capacitive micromachined ultrasonic transducer (L-CMUT) employing electrostatically actuated in-plane microbeams was introduced as a broadband MEMS transducer concept. However, a comprehensive investigation of its acoustic radiation behavior and quantitative validation of corresponding multiphysics models have not yet been reported. In this work, we present a combined experimental and numerical characterization of a previously reported L-CMUT device operating between 10 kHz and 60 kHz. A coupled electrostatic--structural--thermoviscous finite-element model is combined with an acoustic boundary-element formulation to investigate the complete transduction chain from electrostatic actuation to acoustic radiation. The numerical predictions are validated experimentally using spherical near-field acoustic holography, enabling reconstruction of three-dimensional directivity patterns, radiated acoustic power, and spherical harmonic representations of the radiated sound field. The results show that the broadband behavior originates from strong thermoviscous damping within the narrow beam--stator cavities, resulting in strongly overdamped operation despite a mechanical eigenfrequency near 50 kHz. Good agreement between simulations and measurements is obtained for radiation patterns, radiated sound power, and spherical harmonic content. Furthermore, horn loading primarily redistributes acoustic energy and modifies directivity while only weakly affecting the total radiated acoustic power.

summaries.en: This study combines a coupled electrostatic-structural-thermoviscous finite-element model with acoustic boundary-element formulation and validates it against spherical near-field acoustic holography measurements to show that a broadband lateral CMUT's response arises from strong thermoviscous damping in the narrow beam-stator cavities despite a mechanical eigenfrequency near 50 kHz.
summaries.zh: 本研究将静电-结构-热粘性耦合有限元模型与声学边界元方法相结合，并通过球形近场声全息测量进行验证，结果表明该宽带横向CMUT的宽带特性源于狭窄梁-定子腔内的强热粘性阻尼，尽管其机械本征频率接近50 kHz。
summaries.ja: 本研究は、静電-構造-熱粘性連成有限要素モデルと音響境界要素法を組み合わせ、球面近距離場音響ホログラフィ測定で検証することにより、この広帯域横型CMUTの広帯域特性が、約50 kHzの機械固有周波数にもかかわらず狭い梁-固定子キャビティ内の強い熱粘性減衰に起因することを示した。

title: Microlens-Integrated Grating Couplers for Efficient Free-Space Coupling in Silicon Photonics
abstract: Grating-coupler arrays are used to couple free-space light into photonic chips, but the space required for tapers and routing waveguides limits their optical fill factor. Microlens arrays can increase the effective fill factor by collecting light over a larger area and focusing it onto each grating. Separately fabricated lens arrays, however, require assembly and precise alignment to the chip. Here we integrate refractive microlenses directly with high-efficiency, normal-incidence grating couplers using two-photon polymerization. Each lens has a 100 x 100 um2 aperture and focuses incident light onto the grating. Writing the lens body at coarse resolution and the optical surface at fine resolution reduces the print time from 9 h to 19 min per lens. Under illumination by a Gaussian beam with a 276 um mode-field diameter, a printed lens increases the measured coupled power by a factor of 33 (15.2 dB) relative to the same grating before printing. Loss normalization gives an estimated lens-to-mode efficiency of 68%. The lenses show no measurable change in coupling after three 3 h thermal cycles at 150C. These results support direct printing as an approach to increasing free-space collection while simplifying lens integration in photonic systems.

title: Scalar-Longitudinal Modes of Extended Electrodynamics in Perfectly Conducting Waveguides and Divergence Cleaning Interpretation
abstract: Extended electrodynamics keeps the scalar combination $C=\nabla\cdot\mathbf{A}+\mu_0\varepsilon_0\partial\Phi/\partial t$ as a dynamical field rather than imposing the Lorenz gauge condition, and this scalar adds a scalar-longitudinal (SL) family to the TE, TM and TEM modes. With $C=0$ on the wall of a closed perfectly conducting waveguide, the classical modes are unchanged. The SL modes have $\mathbf{B}=0$ and an electric field along $\nabla C$, and their cutoffs are the Dirichlet eigenvalues of the cross-section, the same as the TM cutoffs, with no coaxial TEM counterpart. Charge-conserving sources with zero scalar data do not excite them. Matching at a conductor described by its constitutive laws gives $\partial C/\partial n=0$ instead and couples the scalar-bearing modes to the Maxwell field. The results belong to the $C=0$ problem, the condition that separates the sectors and the one divergence cleaning uses, with benchmarks for the rectangular, circular cylinder, coaxial and L-shaped guides.

summaries.en: In perfectly conducting waveguides with C=0 on the walls, extended electrodynamics leaves the TE, TM and TEM modes unchanged while adding scalar-longitudinal modes with B=0, electric field along ∇C, and Dirichlet cutoffs matching the TM case, which are not excited by charge-conserving sources with zero scalar data and which, under a constitutive conductor boundary giving ∂C/∂n=0, couple to the Maxwell field.

title: Coupled Loop-within-Loop Resonators at the near-field: Extended Bandwidth and Short Pulse Response upon Parametric Conversion
abstract: Parametric frequency conversion have seen a renewed interest, specifically in superconducting quantum circuits at GHz range. These nonlinear convertors are typically narrow band and one may wish to extend their frequency range. Here, two coupled resonators are investigated: a loop-within-loop structure, whose gap is coupled by short, a diode, or simply left open. While simulations and experimental results are limited to GHz range, the concept is general. On their own, the loops exhibit natural frequencies of ca, f=1.5 GHz and f/2=0.73 GHz, respectively; the coupling modifies the resonance frequencies and increases its bandwidth. In one example, signal is fed from one loop and is received by the other. In another example, the input signal is provided across a coupling diode and is received by either loops. It is shown that in the case of nonlinear coupling, the frequency bandwidth can be as large as 3 GHz. Such bandwidth is associated with a very narrow temporal response of less than 150 ps, suggesting coherent effects through high-harmonic excitations at the near-field.

summaries.en: Coupled loop-within-loop resonators with nonlinear (diode) coupling can achieve parametric frequency conversion bandwidths as large as 3 GHz, accompanied by temporal responses shorter than 150 ps that suggest coherent high-harmonic near-field effects.
summaries.zh: 采用非线性（二极管）耦合的环中环耦合谐振器可实现高达3 GHz的参量频率转换带宽，并伴随短于150 ps的时间响应，表明近场中存在相干高次谐波效应。

title: Experimental Optimization of a Cryogenic Buffer Gas Source for Molecular Magneto-optical Traps
abstract: Molecular magneto-optical traps (MOTs) are loaded from cryogenic buffer gas beam (CBGB) sources, which produce a large flux of cold molecules. However, only a small fraction of this flux is slowed and captured. Here, we investigate and optimize one of these CBGB sources through a combination of experiment and simulation to maximize the number of molecules loaded into a MOT of CaF molecules. We experimentally determine the range of molecule velocities from the source that are successfully slowed and captured in the MOT, and perform a systematic study of buffer gas source geometries to identify designs that maximize MOT loading. Our observations agree well with Monte Carlo simulations, which provide physical insight into the dynamics within the source and explain how source geometry influences the subset of molecules that are ultimately trapped. These results provide practical design guidelines for optimizing cryogenic buffer gas beam sources used in laser cooling experiments.

summaries.en: Experiments and Monte Carlo simulations were combined to optimize a cryogenic buffer gas beam source for CaF molecules, identifying source geometries that maximize the number of molecules loaded into a magneto-optical trap and explaining how geometry influences which molecules are ultimately slowed and captured.
summaries.zh: 结合实验与蒙特卡罗模拟优化了用于CaF分子的低温缓冲气体束源，确定了能使磁光阱装载分子数最大化的源几何结构，并解释了几何结构如何影响最终被减速和捕获的分子。
summaries.ja: CaF分子の磁気光学トラップへの装填数を最大化するよう、実験とモンテカルロシミュレーションを組み合わせて極低温バッファーガスビーム源を最適化し、どの分子が最終的に減速・捕捉されるかに源の形状がどう影響するかを明らかにした。

title: Coherent dynamics and ultrafast evolution of optical nonlinearity of self-hybridized exciton-polaritons in WSe2
abstract: Exciton-polaritons (EPs) are valuable for investigating macroscopic quantum coherent phenomena. However, overcoming the rapid decoherence of EPs under ambient conditions is challenging, even using delicately fabricated optical cavities. Here, we show pronounced coherent dynamics in thin flakes of WSe2 supporting self-hybridized EPs. Ultrafast two-dimensional electronic spectroscopy (2DES) resolves two types of quantum beating: Rabi oscillation with a period of ~ 24 fs and a slower, ~ 50 fs period oscillation, revealing coherent coupling not only between excitons and cavity, but also between polaritons and dark states. Rapid evolution of 2DES line shape indicates a change of dominant optical nonlinearities from Rabi contraction of polaritons to many-body interactions of excitons in the first 100 fs, marking the transition from coherent to incoherent polariton excitations. The results are rationalized by a three-coupled oscillator model considering the inhomogeneous cavity field distribution. We also demonstrate coherent quantum beating between A exciton and its excited Rydberg state A* under ambient conditions. Our results shed light on the coherent control in readily accessible semiconductor thin flakes.

summaries.en: Ultrafast two-dimensional electronic spectroscopy of self-hybridized exciton-polaritons in thin WSe2 flakes reveals ~24 fs Rabi oscillations and ~50 fs polariton-dark-state beats, with the optical nonlinearity shifting from Rabi contraction of polaritons to many-body exciton interactions within the first 100 fs, marking the coherent-to-incoherent polariton transition and enabling coherent A-exciton–Rydberg-state beating at ambient conditions.
summaries.zh: 对薄层WSe2中自杂化激子极化激元的超快二维电子光谱测量揭示了约24飞秒的Rabi振荡和约50飞秒的极化激元-暗态拍频，且光学非线性在最初100飞秒内从极化激元的Rabi收缩转变为激子的多体相互作用，标志着极化激元由相干激发向非相干激发的过渡，并在环境条件下实现了A激子与其Rydberg激发态之间的相干量子拍频。
summaries.ja: 薄片WSe2中の自己ハイブリッド励起子ポラリトンに対する超高速二次元電子分光により、約24 fsのラビ振動と約50 fsのポラリトン–暗状態間のビートが観測され、最初の100 fsで光学非線形性がポラリトンのラビ収縮から励起子の多体相互作用へと変化してコヒーレントからインコヒーレントなポラリトン励起への遷移を示すとともに、常温環境下でA励起子とそのリュードベリ励起状態間のコヒーレント量子ビートを実証した。

title: Dynamics of liquid jet breakup and droplet size distribution in a crossflow airstream
abstract: The fragmentation of a liquid jet in a crossflowing airstream arises from a complex interplay between aerodynamic forcing and interfacial instabilities acting across a wide range of length scales. We examine the spatial evolution of droplet size distributions along the jet trajectory using a combination of high-speed shadowgraphy and digital in-line holography, allowing simultaneous characterization of jet morphology and volumetric droplet size distributions. The results demonstrate a clear progression of breakup mechanisms, from near-field bag rupture to downstream rim, ligament, and node disintegration, each associated with distinct characteristic length scales. This evolution is reflected in the droplet size distributions, which broaden and become increasingly polydisperse downstream relative to the near-field distributions. By systematically varying the liquid-jet and airstream Weber numbers, we identify distinct breakup modes, and construct a regime map that delineates the column-breakup, isolated-bag-breakup, and interacting-bag regimes. Furthermore, by incorporating the dominant instability mechanisms, including Rayleigh-Taylor and Rayleigh-Plateau instabilities associated with the observed column, bag, and multi-bag breakup modes, we develop a theoretical framework for jet atomization in crossflow. The framework relates instability wavelengths to characteristic droplet sizes, and reasonably captures the experimentally observed trends. We found that stronger aerodynamic forcing induces earlier breakup, decreases the characteristic instability length scales, and generates finer droplets dispersed over a wider spatial region. Overall, the study establishes a quantitative relationship between instability-driven fragmentation dynamics and droplet size distributions, thereby connecting interfacial instabilities with measurable spray characteristics.

summaries.en: Using high-speed shadowgraphy and digital in-line holography, the study links instability-driven breakup mechanisms—bag, rim, ligament, and node disintegration—to progressively broader droplet size distributions, and constructs a Weber-number regime map plus a theoretical framework relating Rayleigh-Taylor and Rayleigh-Plateau instability wavelengths to characteristic droplet sizes in liquid jets in crossflow.
summaries.zh: 该研究结合高速阴影成像与数字同轴全息技术，将袋状破裂、边缘、韧带和节点破碎等由不稳定性驱动的破碎机制与逐渐变宽的液滴尺寸分布相联系，并构建了韦伯数流型图以及将瑞利-泰勒和瑞利-普拉托不稳定性波长与横向气流中液流特征液滴尺寸相关联的理论框架。
summaries.ja: 高速シャドウグラフィーとデジタルインラインホログラフィーを組み合わせ、バッグ破裂やリム・リガメント・ノードの崩壊といった不安定性に駆動される分裂機構を、下流に向かって広がる液滴径分布と関連づけ、ウェーバー数による流動様式マップと、レイリー・テイラー不安定性およびレイリー・プラトー不安定性の波長を横流れ気流中の液体ジェットの特徴的液滴径に関係づける理論枠組みを構築した。

title: Higher-Order Flatband-Touching Points Mediate Unconventional Bulk-Boundary Correspondence
abstract: The bulk-boundary correspondence establishes a fundamental connection between bulk band topology and the emergence of boundary states, underpinning topological phenomena across electronic, acoustic, photonic, and many other wave systems. A broad class of singular flatband systems, however, exhibits an unconventional form of bulk-boundary correspondence, in which robust boundary modes (RBMs) originate from flatband-touching points (FBTPs) and the real-space topology associated with incomplete sets of compact localized states (CLSs), rather than conventional momentum-space bulk topological invariants. To date, experimental studies of such boundary modes have been limited to systems hosting lower-order FBTPs. Here, we experimentally demonstrate unconventional bulk-boundary correspondence in a photonic cross-bedded Kagome-like lattice featuring a higher-order FBTP formed by the touching of two degenerate flatbands and a dispersive band. Using continuous-wave laser writing, we observe shape-preserving propagation of both bulk CLSs and boundary RBMs. Remarkably, unlike previously reported flatband systems, the RBMs retain their boundary localization under input-field perturbations involving both singular and nonsingular CLSs, revealing an unconventional boundary response associated with the higher-order FBTP in this lattice. Our results establish the Kagome-like lattice as a new platform for exploring flatband physics and unconventional bulk-boundary correspondence, with potential applications in wave localization, flatband lasers, and other emerging topological photonic devices.

summaries.en: This paper experimentally demonstrates in a photonic cross-bedded Kagome-like lattice that a higher-order flatband-touching point, formed by two degenerate flatbands touching a dispersive band, mediates an unconventional bulk-boundary correspondence in which robust boundary modes arise from real-space topology of incomplete compact localized state sets and remain localized under input-field perturbations.
summaries.zh: 本文在光子交叉层状类Kagome晶格中实验证明，由两个简并平带与一个色散带相接触形成的高阶平带接触点介导了一种非常规的体-边对应，其中鲁棒边界模式源于不完全紧局域态集合的实空间拓扑，并在输入场扰动下保持局域化。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、2つの縮退フラットバンドと分散バンドの接触により形成される高次フラットバンド接触点が、不完全なコンパクト局在状態集合の実空間トポロジーに由来するロバストな境界モードを生み出し、入力場の摂動下でも局在を保つ非従来型のバルク-境界対応を、フォトニックな交差層状カゴメ様格子において実験的に実証した。

title: Light pulse propagation through a dielectric slab. I. Retarded integral equations and their local finite-difference solution
abstract: We describe the propagation of a nonresonant light pulse normally incident on a thin dielectric slab using an integral-equation approach to electromagnetism. This emerges naturally from the microscopic picture of the material as made of polarizable atoms, confined within the material vacuum volume by their bonding interactions, each responding to the input radiation pulse as well as to the re-radiated pulses of the other atoms to which it is causally connected. The retarded integral equations are shown to be exactly equivalent to a local wave equation coupled to an auxiliary Lorentz-oscillator equation, which we solve numerically with a finite-difference time-domain scheme. For a slab thick enough that the front- and back-surface reflections are temporally separated, the front-surface reflectivity extracted from the simulation agrees with the Fresnel formula to within 1 percent, and the back-surface echo appears at exactly the expected round-trip delay. For a slab thinner than one optical cycle, the multiply-reflected wavelets overlap and interfere, and a full space-time map of the field directly visualizes the build-up of thin-film-like interference in the time domain. The material parameters used here are illustrative rather than fitted to measured data, and the numerical scheme is verified by an explicit grid-convergence study. In a companion paper (Paper II) the retarded integral equations are solved directly, without the local reformulation, and the two independent numerical solutions are shown to agree.

summaries.en: The paper shows that retarded integral equations describing a nonresonant light pulse propagating through a thin dielectric slab are exactly equivalent to a local wave equation coupled to an auxiliary Lorentz-oscillator equation, which is solved by finite-difference time-domain simulation yielding front-surface reflectivity within 1% of the Fresnel formula and visualizing thin-film interference in time for sub-cycle-thickness slabs.
summaries.zh: 本文表明，描述非共振光脉冲在薄介电平板中传播的推迟积分方程，可严格等价地转化为与辅助洛伦兹振子方程耦合的局部波动方程，并用时域有限差分法求解，所得前表面反射率与菲涅耳公式吻合到1%以内，并能对薄于一光学周期的平板在时域中直接可视化薄膜干涉的建立过程。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、非共鳴光パルスが薄い誘電体スラブを伝播する様子を記述する遅延積分方程式が、補助的なローレンツ振動子方程式と結合した局所波動方程式に厳密に等価であることを示し、有限差分時間領域法で解くことで前面反射率がフレネル式と1%以内で一致し、光学的1周期より薄いスラブでは薄膜干渉の時間的発達を時空間マップとして可視化できることを明らかにした。

title: Quasi-Phase-Matched Second Harmonic Generation in Poling-Free Lithium Niobate Microrings with Surface Molecular Pattern
abstract: Thin film lithium niobate (TFLN) is a promising integrated photonic platform owing to its large quadratic nonlinearity enabling vital applications such as second-harmonic generation (SHG), optical parametric amplification, and spontaneous parametric down-conversion. However, to achieve high SH conversion efficiency, quasi-phase matching (QPM) through periodic electrical poling is typically required, which remains challenging in certain applications like multiple-ring coupled devices. Here, we demonstrate a surface molecule patterning strategy to enable QPM in a poling-free TFLN microring for SHG. An on-chip normalized conversion efficiency of approximately 11.5%/W is obtained in the poling-free TFLN microring with surface molecular pattern, showing an approximate 400-fold improvement compared to the same microring without surface molecular pattern. This approach offers a versatile route to engineer interfacial nonlinear interactions for nonlinear optics and quantum photonics applications and may be extended to multiple-ring coupled resonators and other platforms.

summaries.en: A surface molecular patterning strategy achieves quasi-phase-matched second-harmonic generation in a poling-free thin-film lithium niobate microring with an on-chip normalized conversion efficiency of about 11.
summaries.zh: 一种表面分子图案化策略在无需极化的薄膜铌酸锂微环中实现了准相位匹配的二次谐波产生，片上归一化转换效率约为11.
summaries.ja: 表面分子パターニング法により、ポーリング不要の薄膜リチウムナイオベートマイクロリングにおいて擬似位相整合第二高調波発生を実現し、オンチップ正規化変換効率約11.

title: A compact ultracold strontium experiment
abstract: We describe a compact and simplified experimental setup for the production of ultracold strontium atoms. Thanks to its low-power oven and coil-free Zeeman slower design, the vacuum system has an overall length of only 40cm including oven, Zeeman slower and all-glass science cell. The oven has a power consumption of 14W at 460°C and produces a collimated flux of 3 10^10at/(s cm^2) at this temperature. The laser system employs master-slave laser architecture throughout and requires neither second-harmonic generation nor tapered amplifiers, reducing cost and complexity. The system has been in continuous use for more than a year.

summaries.en: A compact ultracold strontium apparatus with a low-power oven, a coil-free Zeeman slower, and a 40 cm vacuum system enables simplified master-slave laser operation without second-harmonic generation or tapered amplifiers.
summaries.zh: 一套紧凑的超冷锶实验装置采用低功率加热炉、无线圈塞曼减速器和仅40厘米长的真空系统，配合全主从激光架构，无需二次谐波产生或锥形放大器即可运行。
summaries.ja: 低出力オーブン、コイル不要のゼーマン減速器、全長40cmの真空系を備えたコンパクトな極低温ストロンチウム装置は、第二高調波発生やテーパー増幅器を必要としないマスター・スレーブ型レーザー構成で動作する。

title: Synchronization-Induced Limit Cycles and Hysteresis in Spinor Exciton-Polaritons
abstract: We study the nonlinear dynamics of spinor exciton-polaritons in resonantly pumped microcavities. Using steady-state analysis and computing eigenfrequencies via Bogoliubov-like linearization, we show that multiple Hopf bifurcations beyond conventional bistability occur within specific power regimes and are not associated with stable solutions of the system. Owing to nonlinear excitonic interactions, these transitions occur at different pump powers during forward and backward pump sweeps, leading to pronounced hysteresis between fixed-point and limit-cycle states. In the spinor regime, multiple limit-cycle branches and associated dynamical hysteresis loops emerge due to the interplay of polarization coupling and spin-dependent nonlinearities. We show how the locations of the bifurcation points can be tuned by the pump frequency and other system parameters. Our results identify synchronization as the organizing principle underlying limit-cycle formation, dynamical hysteresis, and bifurcation cascades in driven spinor exciton-polariton microcavities.

summaries.en: Using steady-state analysis and Bogoliubov-like linearization of resonantly pumped spinor exciton-polariton microcavities, the study shows that synchronization organizes multiple Hopf bifurcations, limit-cycle branches, and pronounced dynamical hysteresis between fixed-point and limit-cycle states, with bifurcation points tunable via pump frequency and other system parameters.
summaries.zh: 通过对共振泵浦的自旋激子极化激元微腔进行稳态分析和类Bogoliubov线性化，该研究表明同步是驱动系统中极限环形成、动力学迟滞和分岔级联的组织原则，并揭示了多个Hopf分岔、极限环分支以及可通过泵浦频率等参数调节的分岔点。
summaries.ja: 共鳴ポンピングされたスピン励起子ポラリトン微小共振器の定常状態解析とボゴリューボフ的線形化により、本研究は同期がリミットサイクル形成、動的ヒステリシス、分岐カスケードを支配する組織原理であることを示し、複数のホップ分岐やリミットサイクル分枝、ポンプ周波数などで調整可能な分岐点を明らかにした。

title: Hierarchical Response Theory of Electronegativity from Atomic Mean Inner Potential
abstract: Electronegativity, introduced by Pauling nearly a century ago, remains chemistry's most widely used yet conceptually ambiguous quantity: is it a fixed atomic constant, or does it depend on chemical environment? We resolve this debate by recasting electronegativity as a continuous response function rooted in the Atomic Mean Inner Potential (AMIP), a quantum-mechanical observable accessible through first-principles calculation and, ultimately, electron holography. Expanding the AMIP with respect to fractional electron removal defines a hierarchy of physically distinct coefficients: the static electronegativity $\chi_0$, the Electrostatic Rigidity $\mathcal{R}$---whose sign indicates whether an atom hardens or softens upon oxidation---and the Electrostatic Anharmonic Modulus $\mathcal{A}$. A logarithmic-derivative decomposition links these coefficients to two competing microscopic channels, electronic screening loss and geometric volume collapse, whose balance governs the response of all 102 elements. This competition produces a systematic dichotomy between softening main-group elements and hardening d-block elements, two scaling laws within the transition series (closed-shell stiffening and principal quantum softening), and two anomalies: a pronounced exchange-driven effect at half-filled d$^{5}$ configurations and a near-perfect cancellation in Ce. It also resolves the long-standing Cs--Fr controversy, identifying Fr as a critical element whose near-boundary response is amplified fivefold by relativistic contraction of the 7s orbital. The framework reproduces the classical Allen, Pauling, and Mulliken scales as well as Lewis acidity trends, and makes three falsifiable experimental predictions. It transforms electronegativity from a lookup-table number into a predictive, hierarchically structured quantum descriptor.
subjects: Chemical Physics (physics.chem-ph) ; Materials Science (cond-mat.mtrl-sci); Atomic Physics (physics.atom-ph)

summaries.en: By expanding the Atomic Mean Inner Potential with respect to fractional electron removal, the authors recast electronegativity as a hierarchical response function with static, rigidity, and anharmonic coefficients that are linked through competing screening-loss and volume-collapse channels, reproducing classical scales and yielding falsifiable predictions accessible via electron holography.
summaries.zh: 作者通过将原子平均内势按分数电子移除展开，把电负性重构为具有静态、刚度和非谐系数的层级响应函数，这些系数通过电子屏蔽损失和体积坍缩两个相互竞争通道相联系，再现了经典标度并给出了可通过电子全息术检验的可证伪预测。
summaries.ja: 原子平均内ポテンシャルを分数量の電子除去に対して展開することで、著者らは電気陰性度を静的・剛性・非調和係数を持つ階層的応答関数として再構成し、電子遮蔽損失と体積収縮という競合する二つのチャネルを通じてこれらの係数を結びつけ、古典的スケールを再現するとともに電子ホログラフィーで検証可能な反証可能予測を与えた。

title: Observation of Size-dependent Optical Modes and Confinement in Fin Cavities using Angle-Resolved Cathodoluminescence
abstract: We observe novel optical fringes and emission coherence in laterally formed semiconductor fins using wavelength- and angle-resolved cathodoluminescence (WARCL). These findings demonstrate that cavity mode and emission confinement are directly governed by cavity geometry including cavity dimensions, facet angles, and orientation. In flat fins narrowing the width from 3000 nm to 200 nm sharpens fringe intensity, indicating stronger mode confinement and increased coherence. Finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) simulations confirm that the observed fringes originate from internal reflections among the fin facets, consistent with a Fabry-Pérot (FP) cavity model where the cavity length determines the fringe spacing. FDTD also reveals a transition from multi-mode to single-longitudinal-mode behavior in 200-nm fins, consistent with experimentally observed fringe narrowing. Increasing fin length from 10 {\mu}m to 30 {\mu}m compresses fringe spacing via longer round-trip paths. Conversely, tilting the fin end-facet from 90° to 45° reduces the effective light path length, increasing the incoherent optical emission. Remarkably, this loss can be offset by adjusting the fin length-to-height ratio. Results suggest WARCL is a robust in-situ method for direct characterization of individual dielectric nanocavities, mapping their modal profiles and light directionality as a function of geometry for custom design of nanoscale optical sources and waveguides.

summaries.en: Angle-resolved cathodoluminescence reveals that optical cavity modes and emission confinement in semiconductor fin cavities are governed by geometry—width, length, facet angle, and orientation—with narrowing fins enhancing mode confinement and coherence consistent with a Fabry-Pérot model confirmed by FDTD simulations.
summaries.zh: 角分辨阴极发光研究表明，半导体鳍腔中的光学腔模与发射限制由几何结构（宽度、长度、端面角度和取向）决定，缩小鳍宽会增强模式限制和相干性，这与经FDTD模拟证实的法布里-珀罗模型一致。
summaries.ja: 角度分解カソードルミネッセンスを用いた研究により、半導体フィンキャビティの光学モードと発光閉じ込めは幅・長さ・端面角度・配向といった幾何形状に支配され、フィン幅の縮小がモード閉じ込めとコヒーレンスを高めることが、FDTDシミュレーションで確認されたファブリ・ペロー模型と一致して示された。

title: Passive Phase-Aware Hadamard Decoding: Analytical and Machine-Learning Approaches
abstract: Hadamard-coded optical receivers typically rely on stable interference conditions, which can motivate active optical phase control. We investigate a fixed, intensity-only decoder that embeds four populated modes in an eight-mode interferometer and provides six complementary trigonometric observables through simultaneous power measurements. An analytic transition decoder uses the resulting sign-change patterns without continuous optical phase stabilization. The receiver's intensity-to-observable map is inverted exactly, and an identifiability analysis characterizes exceptional phase configurations and conditional noise sensitivity. An ideal, equal-photon-budget comparison with conventional four-port Hadamard decoding illustrates the potential value of the additional outputs without implying an unconditional advantage. Measurements on programmable photonic processors give 96.19% accuracy for the analytical decoding experiment; a complementary machine-learning analysis reports 98.31% on a held-out experimental trace. These results demonstrate an intensity-only, phase-aware approach to differential Hadamard decoding under the tested conditions, while larger codebooks and hardware-level energy benefits remain topics for future investigation.

summaries.en: The paper presents a fixed, intensity-only phase-aware Hadamard decoder that uses an eight-mode interferometer with four populated modes to derive six complementary trigonometric observables, achieving 96.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出一种固定的、仅强度感知相位的哈达玛解码器，利用一个八模干涉仪（其中四个模式被占用）产生六个互补的三角可观测量，在实验光子处理器数据上解析方法达到96.
summaries.ja: 本論文は、4つのモードを占有した8モード干渉計により6つの相補的な三角観測量を生成する、固定かつ強度のみの位相考慮型アダマール復号器を提案し、実験用フォトニックプロセッサのデータで解析的手法が96.

title: Teaching quantum mechanics in secondary schools: A qubit-first learning path to Bell's inequalities
abstract: Teaching quantum mechanics at the secondary school level remains a major educational challenge. Traditional historical approaches often present the theory as a sequence of disconnected phenomena, requiring extensive prior knowledge of classical physics before students can appreciate the conceptual structure of quantum physics. In this work, we present the design, implementation, and evaluation of a curriculum based on the two state (qubit first) approach, in which the fundamental postulates of quantum mechanics are introduced through mathematically accessible two level systems and realized with light polarization. The curriculum integrates theoretical instruction, laboratory activities, a coherent progression grounded in the interactive simulations, and inquiry based learning into a coherent pathway that progresses from quantum states and superposition to entanglement and the experimental violation of Bell's inequalities. A distinctive feature of the project is the experimental realization of the violation of Bell's inequalities obtained in a newly established quantum optics laboratory in an Italian high school, where students performed, for the first time in Italy, an authentic Bell test using polarization-entangled photons. The same educational framework was adopted for in service teacher professional development courses. Learning outcomes were evaluated through mixed methods. Preliminary analysis indicates significant improvements in conceptual understanding, confidence in using mathematical formalism, and appreciation of the relationship between theory, experimentation, and the foundations of quantum mechanics. The proposed curriculum shows that two-state formalism and supported by real laboratory experiences enables secondary-school students to engage more meaningfully with both the conceptual foundations of quantum mechanics and their experimental verification.

summaries.en: A qubit-first curriculum using light polarization and an authentic Bell test with polarization-entangled photons in an Italian high school improved secondary students' conceptual understanding, confidence with mathematical formalism, and appreciation of the link between theory and experiment, with the same framework also used for teacher professional development.
summaries.zh: 一项以量子比特为先、利用光偏振并在意大利高中用偏振纠缠光子进行真实贝尔测试的课程，提升了中学生的概念理解、对数学形式体系的信心以及对理论与实验关系的认识，同一框架也用于教师专业发展培训。
summaries.ja: 量子ビットを出発点とし、光の偏光とイタリアの高校で偏光もつれ光子を用いた本格的なベルテストを組み込んだカリキュラムは、生徒の概念的理���、数学的形式への自信、理論と実験の関係への理解を向上させ、同じ枠組みは教員研修にも用いられた。

title: Broadband Mid-Wave Infrared Imaging Enabled by All-Silicon Hyperboloid Metalens
abstract: The mid-wave infrared (MWIR, 3-5 microns) is indispensable for thermal sensing, gas detection, long-range imaging, and free-space optical communications. Meta-optics offer a compact, lightweight, and potentially low-cost alternative to conventional refractive optics, making them attractive for size, weight, and power (SWaP)-constrained systems. However, their strong chromatic dispersion has largely restricted imaging to narrow spectral bands. Here, we demonstrate broadband imaging across the full 3-5 micron MWIR band using a single-layer silicon metasurface coupled with computational reconstruction. Remarkably, the reconstruction model is adapted using only four image captures, overcoming large training data requirements and enabling broadband image recovery despite the strongly wavelength-dependent optical response. In contrast to approaches that engineer complex, dispersion-optimized metalens profiles for broadband operation, our method leverages the wavelength-dependent information encoded by a simple 2cm diameter hyperboloid metalens. We show that this metasurface captures sufficient broadband intensity information for computational reconstruction across the entire MWIR band. These results establish a simple route toward broadband computational meta-optics without requiring broadband achromatic metalens designs, offering a promising platform for compact MWIR imaging systems.

summaries.en: A single-layer 2 cm diameter silicon hyperboloid metalens combined with computational reconstruction, adapted using only four image captures, enables broadband imaging across the full 3–5 micron mid-wave infrared band without requiring complex achromatic metalens designs.
summaries.zh: 结合计算重建的单层2厘米直径硅双曲面超透镜仅用四次图像采集即可完成模型适配，无需复杂的消色差超透镜设计，便实现了整个3–5微米中波红外波段的宽带成像。
summaries.ja: 単層の直径2cmのシリコン双曲面メタレンズと計算再構成を組み合わせ、わずか4回の画像取得でモデルを適応させることで、複雑な色消しメタレンズ設計を必要とせず、3～5マイクロメートルの中波赤外帯域全体にわたる広帯域イメージングを実現した。

title: International atomic clock comparison achieving $5\times 10^{-18}$ uncertainty
abstract: Two single-ion optical clocks, located in the United Kingdom and in Germany, are compared remotely via a 2220\,km long optical fiber link. Both clocks are based on the ${}^2S_{1/2} (F=0)\leftrightarrow {}^2F_{7/2} (F=3)$ electric octupole (E3) transition in $^{171}\text{Yb}^+$. Using more than $10^6$ seconds of measurement data, we determine a fractional frequency difference of $1.0(4.8)\times 10^{-18}$, demonstrating agreement of the independently developed systems. To our knowledge, this constitutes the first international clock comparison reaching a fractional uncertainty below $5\times 10^{-18}$, an important milestone towards an anticipated optical redefinition of the SI second. The measurement uncertainty is dominated by that of the relativistic redshift correction between the two sites, which includes time-varying gravity potential differences. We exploit the large baseline between the two clocks to search for violations of Lorentz invariance. In the absence of statistically significant modulations, we improve constraints on the Robertson-Mansouri-Sexl parameter $\alpha$ by approximately a factor of five in the uncertainty, and provide limits on corresponding parameters within the Standard-Model Extension framework.

summaries.en: Two independently developed single-ion ytterbium optical clocks in the UK and Germany were compared over a 2220 km fiber link, yielding a fractional frequency difference of 1.
summaries.zh: 英国和德国两台独立研制的镱单离子光钟通过2220公里光纤链路进行了远程比对，测得分数频率差为1.
summaries.ja: 英国とドイツにある独立開発のイッテルビウム単一イオン光時計を2220kmの光ファイバーリンクで遠隔比較し、分数量子周波数差1.

title: Electrically Pumped Quadratic-Soliton Mode-Locked Laser in Lithium Niobate Nanophotonics
abstract: Femtosecond mode-locked lasers are the workhorse of modern photonics, enabling optical atomic clocks, frequency combs, precision spectroscopy, and ultrafast signal processing. Bringing them onto nanophotonic chips promises miniaturized ultrafast systems, yet combining femtosecond pulse generation with electrical pumping remains a major challenge, rooted in a trade-off between the speed and energy efficiency of mode-locking mechanisms. Kerr-based mechanisms offer nearly instantaneous response but typically require high intracavity peak powers that are difficult to achieve with nanophotonic-compatible semiconductor gain. Conversely, semiconductor saturable absorbers enable strong nonlinear responses at low energies but are limited by their slow carrier dynamics. Here we break this trade-off by introducing quadratic-soliton mode-locking based on a quadratic nonlinear interferometer (QNLI): an effective saturable absorber built from cascaded second-order nonlinearity in periodically poled lithium niobate nanophotonics, with a measured sub-20 fs response time. Through hybrid integration with an electrically pumped semiconductor gain element, we demonstrate a self-starting quadratic-soliton mode-locked laser with femtojoule pulse energies, operating in single- and multiple-soliton states. Quadratic solitons arise through the QNLI's dissipative and dispersive nonlinear response, which we confirm with a modified complex Ginzburg-Landau equation in agreement with measurements. By combining soliton formation with intracavity electro-optic modulation, we generate 750 fs pulses with flat-top spectra. Our engineerable, ultra-energy-efficient, electrically powered laser provides the critical source for fully integrated ultrafast photonic circuits in lithium niobate nanophotonics that natively offers electro-optic control, quadratic wavelength conversion, pulse compression, and spectral broadening.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates an electrically pumped, self-starting quadratic-soliton mode-locked laser using a quadratic nonlinear interferometer in periodically poled lithium niobate nanophotonics hybrid-integrated with a semiconductor gain element, achieving femtojoule pulse energies and, with intracavity electro-optic modulation, 750 fs pulses with flat-top spectra.
summaries.zh: 该论文利用周期性极化铌酸锂纳米光子学中的二次非线性干涉仪作为有效可饱和吸收体，并与电泵浦半导体增益元件混合集成，实现了自启动的二次孤子锁模激光器，具有飞焦级脉冲能量，并通过腔内电光调制产生光谱为平顶的750飞秒脉冲。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、周期分極反転ニオブ酸リチウムナノフォトニクスにおける二次非線形干渉計を有効な可飽和吸収体として用い、電気励起半導体利得素子とハイブリッド集積することで、フェムトジュール級のパルスエネルギーを持つ自発振の二次ソリトン受動モード同期レーザーを実現し、さらに腔内電気光学変調によりフラットトップスペクトルを持つ750 fsパルスを生成した。

title: Phonon-assisted free-electron recoil control and mechanical sensing
abstract: Mechanical vibrations are fundamental to a wide range of physical phenomena and technologies, yet their ability to actively shape free-electron dynamics remains largely unexplored. Here we theoretically show how an optomechanical membrane provides a phonon-assisted optical interface for controlling free-electron recoil and sensing localized forces. Transverse membrane motion scatters cavity light into high-momentum evanescent sidebands that enable phase-matched interaction with electrons traveling in vacuum. Beyond supplying momentum for phase matching, the vibration amplitude controls the electron-light interaction strength and redistributes electron populations among recoil orders. External forces that perturb the vibration are thereby encoded in the electron recoil spectrum. Under the modeled conditions, electron readout of localized stochastic forces can yield a higher signal-to-noise ratio than a Gaussian optical homodyne benchmark at equal detected probe rates. These results provide a theoretical basis for mechanically reconfigurable free-electron optics and mode-selective mechanical sensing.
subjects: Optics (physics.optics) ; Other Condensed Matter (cond-mat.other); High Energy Physics - Theory (hep-th); Quantum Physics (quant-ph)

summaries.en: This theoretical work shows that an optomechanical membrane can serve as a phonon-assisted optical interface whose vibration amplitude controls free-electron recoil and interaction strength, thereby encoding localized forces in the electron recoil spectrum with potentially higher signal-to-noise ratio than Gaussian optical homodyne detection.

title: Bias-Preserving Entanglement of Kerr-Cat Qubits with an ATS Coupler
abstract: Kerr-cat qubits offer a hardware-efficient route to fault-tolerant quantum computing by suppressing bit-flip errors exponentially, while phase-flip errors increase only linearly with the mean photon number. To maintain this protection, entangling operations must be bias-preserving, ensuring that phase-flip errors occurring during the gate do not propagate into bit-flip errors. In this paper, we propose an asymmetrically threaded SQUID (ATS) parametric coupler to implement high-fidelity, bias-preserving entangling gates between Kerr-cat qubits. By engineering a photon-number asymmetry between the control and target modes, we enable fast gate operations that suppress non-adiabatic leakage without complex pulse shaping. Through numerical simulations of the full circuit Hamiltonian, we demonstrate a bias-preserving CX gate achieving 99.69% fidelity in the absence of photon loss for a gate duration of 50 ns. Under a single-photon loss rate of 100 kHz, our protocol yields a noise bias of 9922, exceeding the noise bias of a naive non-bias-preserving CX implementation by approximately a factor of 570. These results support the ATS coupler as a valuable building block for concatenated cat-qubit architectures.

summaries.zh: 该论文提出一种非对称线程式SQUID（ATS）参量耦合器，用于在Kerr-cat量子比特之间实现高保真、保持偏置的CX门，在无光子损耗时50 ns门时间内达到99.

title: Low-field dephasing time of an optically polarized NV$^-$ spin bath beyond the P1 limit in diamond: a cluster-correlation-expansion and exact spin-bath study
abstract: Dense ensembles of nitrogen-vacancy (NV$^-$) centres in nitrogen-rich diamond dephase on the electron spins of the substitutional nitrogen (P1) centres. If the paramagnetic nitrogen is instead converted into NV$^-$ centres, the laser that initializes the sensor also pumps the bath into $m_s$ = 0, a state with no moment along its own axis. Using cluster-correlation-expansion (CCE) calculations, combined with an exact solver for probe-bath exchange and with no adjustable parameter, this paper asks whether such an optically polarized NV$^-$ bath dephases a sensor more slowly than a P1 bath of the same density. The answer is set by the field. In a field along [111], three quarters of the bath centres lie off the field axis, and the moment of their $m_s$ = 0 state along the field grows from 0.04 at 25 G to 0.46 at 300 G and 0.81 at 800 G. At 25 G the polarized bath is therefore nearly silent: at $10^{17}$ cm$^{-3}$ the dephasing time $T_2^*$ of a separately addressed $^{15}$NV$^-$ probe is 112 us, six times the 18.1 us of a P1 bath, and still 2.4 times at 90 % polarization; an ensemble measurement gains a factor of two. At 300 G the advantage over P1 shrinks to 1.4, and at 800 G the polarized bath dephases faster than P1. The field dependence of every bath, P1 included, follows the mean moment of its centres along the field. For the Hahn echo, exchange with on-axis bath centres and bath relaxation ($T_1$ = 6 ms) limit the gain to 1.2 times the P1 value at 25 G. Optical polarization of an NV$^-$ bath at low field therefore offers dephasing times beyond the P1 limit of nitrogen-rich diamond.

summaries.en: Using cluster-correlation-expansion calculations and an exact probe-bath solver with no adjustable parameters, the study shows that an optically polarized NV⁻ bath in nitrogen-rich diamond can dephase a sensor more slowly than a P1 bath of equal density at low fields, reaching a T₂* of 112 µs versus 18.
