title: Bounds on Attainable Rate Modulation in Fermi's Golden Rule
abstract: Controlling transition rates is a central objective across quantum optics, condensed-matter physics, and chemical physics, encompassing processes such as spontaneous emission, energy and charge transfer, spin relaxation, and chemical reactions. Although Fermi's golden rule provides a powerful framework for calculating such rates of weakly coupled transitions, conventional calculations require the interaction to be specified in advance; the range of rate responses attainable over a broader interaction space remains unknown. We formulate spectral-overlap golden-rule rates as quadratic forms of the interaction and derive rigorous bounds on rate modulation over a specified interaction space. As an example, application to energy transfer from a donor to a molecular vibration coupled to an optical cavity reveals that enhancement and suppression depend jointly on the interaction and cavity detuning, including continuous reversal of the rate response for a fixed interaction. The same approach may elucidate rate control for other golden-rule processes, including excitation-energy transfer, nonadiabatic electron transfer, nonradiative electronic transitions, vibrational and spin relaxation, and spontaneous emission.

summaries.en: The paper formulates spectral-overlap Fermi's golden-rule rates as quadratic forms of the interaction and derives rigorous bounds on attainable rate modulation over a specified interaction space, illustrating with donor-to-molecular-vibration energy transfer in an optical cavity where enhancement and suppression depend jointly on the interaction and cavity detuning, including continuous reversal of the rate response for a fixed interaction.
summaries.zh: 该论文将谱重叠的费米黄金规则速率表述为相互作用的二次型，并针对给定相互作用空间推导出速率调制可达范围的严格界限，并以供体到与光学腔耦合的分子振动的能量转移为例，表明增强与抑制共同取决于相互作用和腔失谐，包括在固定相互作用下速率响应的连续反转。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、スペクトル重なりに基づくフェルミの黄金律の遷移速度を相互作用の二次形式として定式化し、指定された相互作用空間における速度変調の到達可能範囲に関する厳密な限界を導出し、光共振器に結合した分子振動へのドナーからのエネルギー移動に適用して、増強と抑制が相互作用と共振器離調に共同で依存し、固定した相互作用に対して速度応答が連続的に反転し得ることを示している。

title: Photon Correlations Control Quantum Fisher Information in Coherent Multidimensional Spectroscopy
abstract: Coherent multidimensional spectroscopy probes interactions and dynamics of molecular systems through nonlinear optical signals. Quantum light excitation has been explored as a means of controlling these signals, raising the question of how excitation-light correlations affect the precision of molecular parameter estimation from the emitted signal. In this work, we show that photon-number correlations and two-photon coherence play distinct roles in encoding molecular information in the emitted rephasing signal. In the weak-emission regime and within the single Schmidt pair approximation, we derive a normally ordered information law in which the joint photon-number moment and the squared magnitude of the two-photon coherence weight the amplitude and phase sensitivities of the molecular response, respectively. For matched temporal modes and mean photon numbers in each input mode, two-mode squeezed vacuum enhances both weights relative to coherent excitation, whereas independent displaced squeezing preserves the amplitude weight but reduces the phase weight. The background population and its parameter dependence also affect the total quantum Fisher information, which therefore cannot be inferred from the coherent mean-field signal alone. We derive a leading-order bound on its enhancement over coherent excitation when the background population is nonnegative and common to the compared sources. These findings provide criteria for selecting excitation sources according to how the target molecular parameter affects the amplitude and phase of the response.

summaries.en: This work derives a normally ordered information law showing that in weak-emission coherent multidimensional spectroscopy, photon-number correlations and two-photon coherence respectively weight the amplitude and phase sensitivities of the molecular response, so that two-mode squeezed vacuum, displaced squeezing, and background population distinctly control the total quantum Fisher information beyond what the coherent mean-field signal alone reveals.
summaries.zh: 本文推导出一个正规序信息定律，表明在弱发射相干多维光谱中，光子数关联与双光子相干性分别加权分子响应的幅度与相位灵敏度，因此双模压缩真空、位移压缩以及背景布居对总量子Fisher信息的控制无法仅由相干平均场信号推断。
summaries.ja: 本研究は、弱発光領域のコヒーレント多次元分光において、光子数相関と二光子コヒーレンスがそれぞれ分子応答の振幅感度と位相感度を重み付けする正規順序の情報法則を導出し、二モード圧縮真空・変位圧縮・背景占有分布がコヒーレント平均場信号だけでは推測できない全量子フィッシャー情報を制御することを示す。

title: Quantum-Enhanced Matterwave Interferometry in a Ring Waveguide
abstract: We propose a quantum-enhanced matter-wave interferometry protocol based on fractional-revival dynamics of a Bose-Einstein condensate in a ring, combined with a controlled interaction quench. Using the Truncated Wigner Approximation, we show that nonlinear evolution to the quarter revival generates modest spin squeezing of $-2.03\pm0.28\;$dB, which subsequently degrades under further nonlinear evolution. In contrast, starting from a non-interacting condensate, a controlled interaction quench applied after the initial quarter-revival beam-splitter operation generates substantially stronger spin squeezing of $-14.57\pm0.27\;$dB. We further show that phase control at $t=3T_r/8$ rotates the squeezed quadrature onto the phase-sensitive direction $\hat{J}_y$, producing a phase-squeezed state at $t=T_r/2$. The subsequent quarter-revival evolution converts this phase-squeezed state into a number-squeezed state, enabling population-difference readout. The resulting sequence provides a route to quantum-enhanced interferometry using the intrinsic fractional-revival dynamics of a ring together with controlled interaction and phase operations.

summaries.en: A protocol using fractional-revival dynamics of a ring-trapped Bose-Einstein condensate combined with a controlled interaction quench is shown via the Truncated Wigner Approximation to produce strong spin squeezing of -14.
summaries.zh: 该文通过截断维格纳近似表明，利用环形玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体的分数回复动力学并结合受控相互作用淬火，可获得-14.

title: Two particle interference: The Hanbury Brown Twiss and Hong Ou Mandel experiments
abstract: I discuss two important quantum optics experiments which depend on two particle interference. In the years since their first demonstration many interesting and instructive variants have appeared, including the use of atoms instead of photons as the interfering particles. This chapter gives a pedagogical overview of some of these results and argues that the two effects are closely related.

summaries.en: This pedagogical chapter reviews the Hanbury Brown-Twiss and Hong-Ou-Mandel two-particle interference experiments, including variants using atoms instead of photons, and argues that the two effects are closely related.
summaries.zh: 这篇教学性章节回顾了汉伯里·布朗-特维斯和洪-欧-曼德尔两粒子干涉实验，包括以原子代替光子的变体，并论证这两种效应密切相关。
summaries.ja: この教育的な章では、ハンベリー・ブラウン・トゥイスとホン・オウ・マンデルの二粒子干渉実験を、光子の代わりに原子を用いた変種も含めて概観し、両効果が密接に関連していると論じている。

title: A random sampling method to test the weak Eigenstate Thermalization Hypothesis
abstract: We introduce a random sampling method for testing the weak Eigenstate Thermalization Hypothesis (wETH) that is particularly useful for large, sparse Hamiltonians. We test the method on a well-studied Rydberg atom system that exhibits both two- and three-body dipole-dipole interactions. Our results show that our method allows for the study of system sizes significantly beyond the limits of exact diagonalization. We find that the fluctuations in eigenstate expectation values decay as the Hilbert space dimension $D^{-1/2}$, consistent with wETH and in agreement with previous numerical results.

summaries.en: We introduce a random sampling method for testing the weak Eigenstate Thermalization Hypothesis in large, sparse Hamiltonians and apply it to a Rydberg atom system with two- and three-body dipole-dipole interactions, finding that eigenstate expectation value fluctuations decay as the inverse square root of the Hilbert space dimension, consistent with wETH.
summaries.zh: 我们提出了一种随机采样方法，用于检验大型稀疏哈密顿量中的弱本征态热化假说，并将其应用于一个包含两体和三体偶极-偶极相互作用的里德堡原子系统，发现本征态期望值的涨落随希尔伯特空间维度的平方根倒数衰减，与弱本征态热化假说一致。
summaries.ja: 我々は、大規模で疎なハミルトニアンに対して弱固有状態熱化仮説を検証するためのランダムサンプリング法を導入し、二体および三体双極子-双極子相互作用を示すリュードベリ原子系に適用した結果、固有状態期待値のゆらぎがヒルベルト空間次元の平方根の逆数で減衰し、wETHと一致することを見出した。

title: Pure dephasing destroys two-photon amplitude, not nonlinear phase
abstract: A two-level emitter chirally coupled to a waveguide imprints a $\pi$ conditional phase on a two-photon pulse, a key component assumed in quantum photonic neural network architectures, but whether it survives the pure dephasing of a solid-state emitter is unknown, since no two-photon scattering treatment includes it. We derive the dephased two-photon amplitude in closed form and validate it against an independent Fock-state master equation. The conditional phase is pinned at exactly $\pi$ at every dephasing rate examined: dephasing destroys the amplitude carrying the nonlinear phase rather than rotating it. The one- and two-photon channels are not attenuated equally, so dephasing does not simply scale the node down but reweights it between photon-number sectors---an error no phase setting can train away. The standard factorization of two-photon correlators, exact for arbitrary loss, fails at first order in $\gamma_\phi$, discarding $16$--$81\%$ of pairs over $\gamma_\phi/\gamma=0.1$--$1$.

summaries.en: Pure dephasing in a two-level emitter chirally coupled to a waveguide leaves the conditional two-photon phase pinned at exactly π while destroying the two-photon amplitude and unequally reweighting one- and two-photon channels, an error that standard correlator factorization misses at first order in the dephasing rate.
summaries.zh: 在手性耦合到波导的两能级发射体中，纯退相位使条件双光子相位始终精确保持在π，同时破坏双光子振幅并重新分配单光子和双光子通道的权重，而这种误差在退相位率的一阶项上被标准关联函数因子化所忽略。
summaries.ja: 導波路にカイラル結合した二準位発光体では、純位相緩和は条件付き二光子位相を正確にπに固定したまま二光子振幅を破壊し、一光子・二光子チャネルの重みを不均等に再配分するが、この誤差は位相緩和率の一次で標準的な相関因子分解では捉えられない。

title: Training-Efficient Channel Estimation for the Multiuser Uplink Relying on Generalized Flexible Intelligent Metasurfaces
abstract: We consider uplink multiuser channel estimation for a generalized flexible intelligent metasurface at the base station, under narrowband far-field propagation and a twin-time-scale mechanical protocol: on the slow time-scale the panel translates rigidly over a planar grid, while on the fast time-scale the surface morphs along its normal direction. From orthogonal multiuser pilots, we show that each user's channel admits a fourth-order canonical polyadic tensor structure. We develop two complementary estimators: alternating least squares factorization followed by paired rotational-invariance wavevector extraction, and a tensor spatial-smoothing multiple signal classification estimator that preserves the multilinear array manifold. Both share a minimum description length front-end for automatic tensor-rank detection. We derive Kruskal identifiability conditions that relate the numbers of elements, morphing states and grid positions to the maximum number of recoverable multipath components, and show that the tensor model reconstructs the channel at panel configurations beyond the training grid. This prediction capability drives a configuration-selective multiuser transmit precoder that searches the entire motion grid without additional pilot overhead. Numerical results confirm the identifiability limits and show that, once the model order is resolved, the configuration search makes the same choice from estimated as from perfect channel state information. The reconfiguration gain over a fixed panel of identical aperture and training budget grows with the user load, and fast morphing proves valuable for conditioning the tensor factorization rather than as a source of beamforming gain.

summaries.en: The paper develops two tensor-based estimators—alternating least squares with rotational-invariance wavevector extraction and tensor spatial-smoothing MUSIC, both with MDL rank detection—for uplink multiuser channel estimation with a generalized flexible intelligent metasurface under a twin-time-scale mechanical protocol, derives Kruskal identifiability conditions, and exploits the reconstructed channel to drive a configuration-selective precoder that searches the motion grid without extra pilots.
summaries.zh: 该论文针对采用双时间尺度机械协议的广义柔性智能超表面，提出了两种基于张量的估计器——交替最小二乘结合成对旋转不变波矢量提取，以及保持多线性阵列流形的张量空间平滑MUSIC（两者均以MDL自动检测张量秩）——用于上行多用户信道估计，推导了关联阵元数、形变状态与网格位置同可恢复多径分量上限的Kruskal可辨识条件，并利用重建信道驱动无需额外导频即可搜索整个运动网格的配置选择多用户预编码器。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、二重時間スケールの機械的プロトコル下の一般化フレキシブルインテリジェントメタサーフェスに対し、交互最小二乗法と対の回転不変波数ベクトル抽出、および多線形アレー多様体を保持するテンソル空間平滑化MUSICという二つのテンソルベース推定器（いずれもMDLによるテンソルランク自動検出を備える）を上りマルチユーザチャネル推定のために開発し、素子数・変形状態・グリッド位置と復元可能なマルチパス成分の上限を結ぶKruskal可識別条件を導出するとともに、追加パイロットなしで運動グリッド全体を探索する構成選択型マルチユーザプレコーダを再構成チャネルで駆動することを示す。

title: Multiuser Channel Estimation in FIM Systems: A Structured Block Term Decomposition Approach
abstract: Flexible intelligent metasurfaces (FIMs) create geometry-dependent array responses that provide spatial diversity but complicate multiuser channel estimation. This paper studies uplink estimation using pilot observations collected under multiple prescribed and calibrated morphing configurations. Each user contributes a matrix--vector block that couples its diagonal reference-array response with its morphing-dependent phases, while its third-mode vector is the known pilot scaled by the complex channel gain. We develop a pilot-constrained structured block term decomposition (BTD) estimator whose alternating least-squares updates exploit both the known pilot directions and the diagonal spatial factors. The undeformed configuration sets the columnwise scaling convention, and a unit first-entry normalization assigns the remaining block scale to the channel gain. Matching the recovered factors to the calibrated spatial--morphing manifold then yields the physical angles and configuration-dependent channels. We characterize the rank conditions for unique conditional least-squares updates, distinguish these conditions from global factor and physical-angle identifiability, and summarize the training, coherence-time, and computational requirements. Simulations show accurate two-dimensional angle and channel recovery in the tested settings, equal total pilot-symbol overhead in rigid-panel comparisons, improved steering-vector estimates as morphing diversity increases, and degradation as user loading or pilot correlation increases.

summaries.en: This paper develops a pilot-constrained structured block term decomposition estimator for multiuser uplink channel estimation in flexible intelligent metasurface systems, exploiting known pilot directions and diagonal spatial factors to recover physical angles and configuration-dependent channels under characterized rank and identifiability conditions.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了一种受导频约束的结构化块项分解估计器，用于柔性智能超表面系统中的多用户上行信道估计，利用已知导频方向和 diagonal 空间因子来恢复物理角度及随配置变化的信道，并刻画了相应的秩条件与可辨识性条件。
summaries.ja: 本論文は、柔軟知能メタサーフェスシステムにおけるマルチユーザ上りリンクチャネル推定のため、既知のパイロット方向と対角空間因子を活用して物理角度および構成依存チャネルを回復するパイロット制約付き構造化ブロック項分解推定器を提案し、ランク条件と可識別性条件を特徴付ける。
